summary: Tested the new batch (EN i18n, LiCoLi recipe, oven-ambience controls, install banner) plus regressions after the v34 reseed. Backend: 8/8 pytest checks pass (admin login, bad-password rejection, 43 mikilab recipes, LiCoLi separated from Lievito Madre Solido with 1:1:1 refresh + pH 4,1-4,3, retired name 'Licoli (Liko)' gone, 11 panettoni correctly named, menu_category 'basi' contains both starters, no _id leakage). Frontend (mobile 390x844): EN chip in intro popup and header lang-en switch the whole public UI to English (nav Home/Recipes/Your Lab/Learn/Diagnosis, promo, concept modal 'What is MikiLab', jokes, home sections); IT and DE switching still work. Radio: ambient-toggle shows/hides ambient-volume slider, slider drag sets 0.8, zero console errors. Recipes: 'Basi & Lieviti' lists both Lievito Madre Solido and LiCoLi (Lievito in Coltura Liquida); LiCoLi detail shows its own procedure (1:1:1, pH 4,1-4,3). Admin login + panettone technical structure (panettone-structure-<id>) + 'Converti in Farro' toggle (renames to 'Panettone Artigianale al Farro' and shows farro banner) all still work.

issues: Floating 'Radio' and 'Parla/Talk' FABs sit on top of recipe rows near the bottom of the list (they visually cover the LiCoLi / Lievito Madre di Segale row text). Consider adding bottom padding to the list or offsetting the FABs.
Scene bubble text is clipped/overflowing at the top-left of the photo card (e.g. 'compute doses, hydration and costs' cut off at the edge).

design_issues.screen: Home - Mikilab bio card / Recipes list
issues: Bio card subtitle still shows only 2 flags (IT/DE) while the avatar card shows 3 — inconsistent now that EN exists.
Recipe names are prefixed with a flag emoji with no space ('🇮🇹Panettone Artigianale MikiLab — ...').
Category headers/UI are English but recipe names and subtitles stay Italian (seed data has name_de but no name_en). Acceptable per brief, but EN users see Italian recipe titles.

action_items: Optional: add bottom padding to RecipeList so the Radio/Talk FABs don't overlap the last visible rows
Optional: fix Home scene-bubble text clipping on the founder photo
Optional: add EN flag to the bio card subtitle and a space after the flag emoji in recipe names
Optional: consider name_en/procedure_en in seed data for full EN recipe coverage
critical_code_review_comments: No GET /api/recipes/{id} endpoint exists — detail data comes from the list payload; fine today but PRO gating logic is duplicated per-list-item, keep in mind if recipes grow.
translations.js is ~2100 lines with 3 locales inline; consider splitting per-locale files to keep it maintainable.
seed_data_creation: None (read-only tests; no test records created)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for v34 is /app/backend/tests/test_iter26_v34.py (uses menu_category, not category; recipe detail comes from the list endpoint). Install banner (data-testid install-banner) never rendered in headless Chromium because beforeinstallprompt is not fired -> NOT-APPLICABLE, not a failure; it is correctly rendered from App.js and absent from bottom nav. Language choice persists in localStorage across sessions, so reset lang via header lang-it/lang-de/lang-en at the start of each Playwright run.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no functional defects found in this iteration.
